0022600004.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Minnesota Timberwolves visit the Miami Heat, and Minnesota will be without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery and averaged 12.2 points in 30.4 minutes per game last season. The Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 122-94 win over Miami in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Minnesota a 50% chance of winning.
